gameDescriptionHtml:
A mysterious alien invasion threatens humanity – time has come to a stop for all but your small band of freedom fighters. Caught in a seemingly endless loop, you must shape these ordinary civilians into heroes. Countless lives hang in the balance: you are humanity’s only hope to thwart the invaders.

With every new time loop, newly acquired experience and skills remain. As you explore the multiple districts of your wartorn city, anything you discover in one loop is available to you from the start of the next. Welcome to the resistance!

CONTROL IS IN YOUR HANDS 
Your tactical prowess will be put to the test when the bullets start to fly – armed and positioned appropriately, allies can work closely together to assist one another, interrupt enemy movements, and bring about a quick end to challenging circumstances.

Take direct control of every shot as you aim down the sights, find where your target is weakest, and unleash a hail of bullets. Hit chances are determined entirely by your positioning, your aim, and your reaction time, with ballistics taking firing angles and obstructions into account.

Your resistance fighters can react to both friend and foe across turns on either side. Every individual has access to unique reflex actions to intercept enemy movement and assist allied kills, or to scramble away from enemy fire. Will you reserve your reflexes for defensive maneuvers when things take a turn for the worse, or will you use them to apply constant pressure on the enemy?

YOUR CHOICES MATTER 

  • 12 unique guns, dozens of skills to unlock, and over 100+ different gun attachments & parts (including some with legendary perks). Discover interesting combinations and tailor each character’s loadout to your tactical needs.
  • In war, sacrifices must be made. Will you attempt to save other civilians at the risk of losing your progress? Or will you sacrifice the lives of those frozen in time in the interest of advancing your ultimate goal?
  • Your strategies can make or break an encounter. Sneak around the battlefield to obtain an optimal position, seek out opportunities to use the world around you, or go in guns blazing: every fight is different.
  • Multiple difficulty modes make the game as accessible – or difficult – as you would like. Including Iron Man mode and Forever War mode for those who truly want a challenge.

END THE FOREVER WAR 
Take on a variety of mission types to thwart the alien invaders – shut down their harvesters, defuse their bombs, and take out their occupying troops to gain the skills you need and secure victory.

To break their hold, however, you must ultimately defeat the Rifter leaders. Hard to kill, heavily armored, and dangerously armed, these leaders hold the key to this war – every time one falls, the time loop shifts forward, bringing the Forever War closer to an end.

Your resistance grows stronger with each success, and with each failure – after all, for you, death is only the beginning.

We think you’ll love Every Day We Fight if you enjoy… XCOM® 2, STAR WARS Zero Company™, MENACE, Jagged Alliance 3, Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus, Wartales, Phoenix Point, Warhounds, Cyber Knights: Flashpoint
